title: 蘭斯潮汐發電站
subcategoryTitle: 海洋能與地熱系統技術
subcategoryTitleEn: Ocean energy and geothermal system technology
summary: 法國布列塔尼的蘭斯潮汐電廠 1966 年啟用，是世界第一座大型潮汐電廠，二十四部十 MW 的燈泡式機組裝在七百五十公尺長的堤壩裡；這裡的潮差最大超過十三公尺，機組可以雙向發電，還能當成泵把水多抽一些進來。它也是海洋結構陰極防蝕的先驅。課程定量分析抽水的能量增益、大小潮的能量比、機組流量、潮時的漂移、累計發電量與淤積。
summaryEn: La Rance in Brittany, France, opened in 1966 as the world's first large tidal plant, twenty-four bulb units of ten megawatts in a barrage 750 metres long; tidal range here exceeds thirteen metres at most, and units generate both ways and can also pump extra water in. It pioneered cathodic protection of marine structures too. The course quantifies energy gain from pumping, energy ratio of springs to neaps, unit flow, drift of tide times, cumulative generation and siltation.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 運轉近六十年的第一座大型潮汐電廠：抽水增益、大小潮、潮時漂移與淤積
v30FocusEn: The first large tidal plant, running nearly sixty years: pumping gain, springs and neaps, drift of tide times and siltation

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：蘭斯潮汐發電站
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: La Rance Tidal Power Station
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「潮差蓄能」與「大潮與小潮的能量比」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Energy from tidal range" and "Energy ratio of springs to neaps": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「潮差蓄能」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Energy from tidal range" is correct?
options: 潮差發電在海灣或河口築堤，利用漲退潮造成的堤內外水位差推動低水頭水輪機。
潮汐每天漲退兩次，所以潮汐電廠可以全天候穩定滿載發電。
潮汐每天都一樣大。
optionsEn: A tidal-range plant builds a barrage across a bay or estuary and drives low-head turbines with the level difference created by the tides.
Tides rise and fall twice a day, so a tidal plant can run steadily at full load round the clock.
Tides are the same size every day.
quiz.explanation: 潮差發電在海灣或河口築堤，利用漲退潮造成的堤內外水位差推動低水頭水輪機。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A tidal-range plant builds a barrage across a bay or estuary and drives low-head turbines with the level difference created by the tides. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 潮差蓄能：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Energy from tidal range: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「潮差蓄能」如何決定「蘭斯潮汐發電站」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Energy from tidal range” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “La Rance Tidal Power Station”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 潮差發電在海灣或河口築堤，利用漲退潮造成的堤內外水位差推動低水頭水輪機。每一次潮汐可擷取的位能與蓄水面積成正比、與潮差的平方成正比，所以只有潮差大於約 5 公尺、又有合適地形的少數地點才值得開發。機組多為燈泡貫流式，可以只在退潮時發電，也可以漲退雙向發電甚至兼做抽水來增加水頭。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A tidal-range plant builds a barrage across a bay or estuary and drives low-head turbines with the level difference created by the tides. Potential energy per tide is proportional to basin area and to the square of tidal range, so only the few sites with ranges above about 5 m and suitable geography are worth developing. Units are mostly bulb turbines and may generate on the ebb only, in both directions, or also pump to raise head. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：1966 年 11 月啟用，是世界第一座大型潮汐電廠
steps.observationEn: Project file: Opened in November 1966, it was the world's first large tidal plant
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「潮汐每天漲退兩次，所以潮汐電廠可以全天候穩定滿載發電。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tides rise and fall twice a day, so a tidal plant can run steadily at full load round the clock." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「潮差蓄能」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Energy from tidal range”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 潮差蓄能
knowledge.text: 潮差發電在海灣或河口築堤，利用漲退潮造成的堤內外水位差推動低水頭水輪機。每一次潮汐可擷取的位能與蓄水面積成正比、與潮差的平方成正比，所以只有潮差大於約 5 公尺、又有合適地形的少數地點才值得開發。機組多為燈泡貫流式，可以只在退潮時發電，也可以漲退雙向發電甚至兼做抽水來增加水頭。
knowledge.textEn: A tidal-range plant builds a barrage across a bay or estuary and drives low-head turbines with the level difference created by the tides. Potential energy per tide is proportional to basin area and to the square of tidal range, so only the few sites with ranges above about 5 m and suitable geography are worth developing. Units are mostly bulb turbines and may generate on the ebb only, in both directions, or also pump to raise head.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：潮汐每天漲退兩次，所以潮汐電廠可以全天候穩定滿載發電。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tides rise and fall twice a day, so a tidal plant can run steadily at full load round the clock. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 1966 年 11 月啟用，是世界第一座大型潮汐電廠
knowledge.textEn: Opened in November 1966, it was the world's first large tidal plant

quiz.question: 依「潮差蓄能」的模型 E = ½·ρ·g·A·h² / 3.6×10⁹，一次潮汐蓄水的理論位能最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = ½·ρ·g·A·h² / 3.6×10⁹ for "Energy from tidal range", which value is closest to the theoretical potential energy of the basin for one tide?
quiz.explanation: E = ½·ρ·g·A·h² / 3.6×10⁹；代入 basin = 22.5 km²、rng = 8.2 m，得 2,113 MWh（一次潮汐蓄水的理論位能）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = ½·ρ·g·A·h² / 3.6×10⁹; with basin = 22.5 km², rng = 8.2 m the result is 2,113 MWh (theoretical potential energy of the basin for one tide). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 潮差蓄能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Energy from tidal range: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「潮差蓄能」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Energy from tidal range” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = ½·ρ·g·A·h² / 3.6×10⁹；代入 basin = 22.5 km²、rng = 8.2 m，得 2,113 MWh（一次潮汐蓄水的理論位能）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 rng 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = ½·ρ·g·A·h² / 3.6×10⁹; with basin = 22.5 km², rng = 8.2 m the result is 2,113 MWh (theoretical potential energy of the basin for one tide). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise rng by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：rng 增加 10% 時，結果變為 2,557 MWh（+21.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising rng by 10% changes the result to 2,557 MWh (+21.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 2,113 MWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 rng 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 2,113 MWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in rng with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = ½·ρ·g·A·h² / 3.6×10⁹；代入 basin = 22.5 km²、rng = 8.2 m，得 2,113 MWh（一次潮汐蓄水的理論位能）。
knowledge.textEn: E = ½·ρ·g·A·h² / 3.6×10⁹; with basin = 22.5 km², rng = 8.2 m the result is 2,113 MWh (theoretical potential energy of the basin for one tide).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: rng 增加 10% 時，結果變為 2,557 MWh（+21.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising rng by 10% changes the result to 2,557 MWh (+21.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「潮差蓄能」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Energy from tidal range"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
基座只要夠重，就一定不會被水流推動。
以堤內外的潮位計與機組流量、出力紀錄計算每一潮的實際發電量，與理論位能比較求得擷取係數，並核對潮汐調和預報。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the base is heavy enough, the current can never move it.

Compute actual energy per tide from tide gauges inside and outside the barrage and unit flow and output records, compare with theoretical potential energy to obtain the capture factor, and check against harmonic tide predictions.
quiz.explanation: 以堤內外的潮位計與機組流量、出力紀錄計算每一潮的實際發電量，與理論位能比較求得擷取係數，並核對潮汐調和預報。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute actual energy per tide from tide gauges inside and outside the barrage and unit flow and output records, compare with theoretical potential energy to obtain the capture factor, and check against harmonic tide predictions. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 潮差蓄能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Energy from tidal range: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「潮差蓄能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Energy from tidal range” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以堤內外的潮位計與機組流量、出力紀錄計算每一潮的實際發電量，與理論位能比較求得擷取係數，並核對潮汐調和預報。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute actual energy per tide from tide gauges inside and outside the barrage and unit flow and output records, compare with theoretical potential energy to obtain the capture factor, and check against harmonic tide predictions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：運轉排程要以潮汐預報逐潮最佳化啟停水位，並把水質與底泥監測列為營運許可的例行項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Optimise start and stop levels tide by tide from tidal predictions, and make water-quality and sediment monitoring routine conditions of the operating licence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：堤壩改變了海灣的潮汐交換與沉積型態，可能使堤內淤積、水質惡化；機組與閘門長期浸泡海水，腐蝕與生物附著使過流面變粗糙、效率下降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A barrage changes tidal exchange and sedimentation in the bay and may cause siltation and poorer water quality inside, and turbines and gates immersed in seawater roughen through corrosion and marine growth, lowering efficiency. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以堤內外的潮位計與機組流量、出力紀錄計算每一潮的實際發電量，與理論位能比較求得擷取係數，並核對潮汐調和預報。
knowledge.textEn: Compute actual energy per tide from tide gauges inside and outside the barrage and unit flow and output records, compare with theoretical potential energy to obtain the capture factor, and check against harmonic tide predictions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 運轉排程要以潮汐預報逐潮最佳化啟停水位，並把水質與底泥監測列為營運許可的例行項目。
knowledge.textEn: Optimise start and stop levels tide by tide from tidal predictions, and make water-quality and sediment monitoring routine conditions of the operating licence.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC TS 62600 海洋能—波浪、潮流與其他水流能轉換器系列。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC TS 62600 series: Marine energy – Wave, tidal and other water current converters. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「潮差蓄能」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Energy from tidal range" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 堤壩改變了海灣的潮汐交換與沉積型態，可能使堤內淤積、水質惡化；機組與閘門長期浸泡海水，腐蝕與生物附著使過流面變粗糙、效率下降。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
潮汐每天都一樣大。
optionsEn: A barrage changes tidal exchange and sedimentation in the bay and may cause siltation and poorer water quality inside, and turbines and gates immersed in seawater roughen through corrosion and marine growth, lowering efficiency.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Tides are the same size every day.
quiz.explanation: 堤壩改變了海灣的潮汐交換與沉積型態，可能使堤內淤積、水質惡化；機組與閘門長期浸泡海水，腐蝕與生物附著使過流面變粗糙、效率下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A barrage changes tidal exchange and sedimentation in the bay and may cause siltation and poorer water quality inside, and turbines and gates immersed in seawater roughen through corrosion and marine growth, lowering efficiency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 潮差蓄能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Energy from tidal range: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「潮差蓄能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Energy from tidal range” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 堤壩改變了海灣的潮汐交換與沉積型態，可能使堤內淤積、水質惡化；機組與閘門長期浸泡海水，腐蝕與生物附著使過流面變粗糙、效率下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「蘭斯潮汐發電站」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: A barrage changes tidal exchange and sedimentation in the bay and may cause siltation and poorer water quality inside, and turbines and gates immersed in seawater roughen through corrosion and marine growth, lowering efficiency. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “La Rance Tidal Power Station”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：機組多為燈泡貫流式，可以只在退潮時發電，也可以漲退雙向發電甚至兼做抽水來增加水頭。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Units are mostly bulb turbines and may generate on the ebb only, in both directions, or also pump to raise head.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「潮汐每天漲退兩次，所以潮汐電廠可以全天候穩定滿載發電。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tides rise and fall twice a day, so a tidal plant can run steadily at full load round the clock." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 堤壩改變了海灣的潮汐交換與沉積型態，可能使堤內淤積、水質惡化；機組與閘門長期浸泡海水，腐蝕與生物附著使過流面變粗糙、效率下降。
knowledge.textEn: A barrage changes tidal exchange and sedimentation in the bay and may cause siltation and poorer water quality inside, and turbines and gates immersed in seawater roughen through corrosion and marine growth, lowering efficiency.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 關於「大潮與小潮的能量比」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Energy ratio of springs to neaps" is correct?
options: 潮汐每天都一樣大。
水輪機只能朝一個方向使用。
潮差不是固定的。
optionsEn: Tides are the same size every day.
A water turbine can be used in one direction only.
Tidal range is not constant.
quiz.explanation: 潮差不是固定的。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tidal range is not constant. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 大潮與小潮的能量比：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Energy ratio of springs to neaps: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「大潮與小潮的能量比」如何決定「蘭斯潮汐發電站」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Energy ratio of springs to neaps” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “La Rance Tidal Power Station”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 潮差不是固定的。每個月的新月與滿月前後，太陽與月球的引力方向一致，潮差最大，叫大潮；上弦與下弦月前後兩者互相抵消，潮差最小，叫小潮。蘭斯的大潮超過十三公尺，小潮卻只有四五公尺。可擷取的能量與潮差的平方成正比，所以大潮時一次潮汐的能量是小潮的七倍。電廠的出力因此有一個兩星期的週期：這幾天滿載運轉，下個星期卻只能發出零頭。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tidal range is not constant. Around new and full moon each month the pulls of sun and moon line up and range is greatest, spring tides; around the quarters they partly cancel and range is least, neaps. At La Rance springs exceed thirteen metres and neaps are only four or five. Energy available goes as the square of range, so one spring tide carries seven times a neap. Plant output thus has a fortnightly cycle, full load for some days and a fraction the week after. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：裝置容量 240 MW，由 24 部各 10 MW 的燈泡式機組組成
steps.observationEn: Project file: Capacity is 240 MW in 24 bulb units of 10 MW each
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「潮汐每天都一樣大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tides are the same size every day." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「大潮與小潮的能量比」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Energy ratio of springs to neaps”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 潮差不是固定的。每個月的新月與滿月前後，太陽與月球的引力方向一致，潮差最大，叫大潮；上弦與下弦月前後兩者互相抵消，潮差最小，叫小潮。蘭斯的大潮超過十三公尺，小潮卻只有四五公尺。可擷取的能量與潮差的平方成正比，所以大潮時一次潮汐的能量是小潮的七倍。電廠的出力因此有一個兩星期的週期：這幾天滿載運轉，下個星期卻只能發出零頭。
knowledge.textEn: Tidal range is not constant. Around new and full moon each month the pulls of sun and moon line up and range is greatest, spring tides; around the quarters they partly cancel and range is least, neaps. At La Rance springs exceed thirteen metres and neaps are only four or five. Energy available goes as the square of range, so one spring tide carries seven times a neap. Plant output thus has a fortnightly cycle, full load for some days and a fraction the week after.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tides are the same size every day. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 依「大潮與小潮的能量比」的模型 r = (h_s / h_n)²，大潮潮差 13.5 m 相對於小潮潮差 5 m 的能量比最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model r = (h_s / h_n)² for "Energy ratio of springs to neaps", which value is closest to the energy ratio of a 13.5 m spring range to a 5 m neap range?
optionsEn: 7.3 times
72.9 times
3.65 times
quiz.explanation: r = (h_s / h_n)²；代入 hs = 13.5 m、hn = 5 m，得 7.3 倍（大潮潮差 13.5 m 相對於小潮潮差 5 m 的能量比）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: r = (h_s / h_n)²; with hs = 13.5 m, hn = 5 m the result is 7.3 times (energy ratio of a 13.5 m spring range to a 5 m neap range). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 大潮與小潮的能量比：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Energy ratio of springs to neaps: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「大潮與小潮的能量比」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Energy ratio of springs to neaps” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：r = (h_s / h_n)²；代入 hs = 13.5 m、hn = 5 m，得 7.3 倍（大潮潮差 13.5 m 相對於小潮潮差 5 m 的能量比）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 hs 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: r = (h_s / h_n)²; with hs = 13.5 m, hn = 5 m the result is 7.3 times (energy ratio of a 13.5 m spring range to a 5 m neap range). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise hs by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：hs 增加 10% 時，結果變為 8.8 倍（+21.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising hs by 10% changes the result to 8.8 times (+21.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 7.3 倍（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 hs 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 7.3 times (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in hs with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: r = (h_s / h_n)²；代入 hs = 13.5 m、hn = 5 m，得 7.3 倍（大潮潮差 13.5 m 相對於小潮潮差 5 m 的能量比）。
knowledge.textEn: r = (h_s / h_n)²; with hs = 13.5 m, hn = 5 m the result is 7.3 times (energy ratio of a 13.5 m spring range to a 5 m neap range).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: hs 增加 10% 時，結果變為 8.8 倍（+21.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising hs by 10% changes the result to 8.8 times (+21.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「大潮與小潮的能量比」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Energy ratio of springs to neaps"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較大潮與小潮期間每一潮的實際發電量，檢驗它與潮差平方的關係並找出機組容量的限制。
可以預測的電源就是可以調度的電源。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Actual energy of each tide at springs and neaps is compared to test the square law and find where unit capacity limits output.
A source that can be predicted is a source that can be dispatched.
quiz.explanation: 比較大潮與小潮期間每一潮的實際發電量，檢驗它與潮差平方的關係並找出機組容量的限制。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Actual energy of each tide at springs and neaps is compared to test the square law and find where unit capacity limits output. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 大潮與小潮的能量比：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Energy ratio of springs to neaps: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「大潮與小潮的能量比」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Energy ratio of springs to neaps” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較大潮與小潮期間每一潮的實際發電量，檢驗它與潮差平方的關係並找出機組容量的限制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Actual energy of each tide at springs and neaps is compared to test the square law and find where unit capacity limits output. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：裝置容量要以全年潮差的分布與邊際發電量決定，電網則須準備應付兩週一次的出力起伏。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Size capacity from the yearly distribution of range and marginal energy, and have the grid ready for the fortnightly swing in output.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：機組容量若只按平均潮差選定，大潮時來不及把水全部通過水輪機，多餘的能量只能經閘門放掉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Units sized on mean range alone cannot pass all the water at springs, and surplus energy goes out through the sluices. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較大潮與小潮期間每一潮的實際發電量，檢驗它與潮差平方的關係並找出機組容量的限制。
knowledge.textEn: Actual energy of each tide at springs and neaps is compared to test the square law and find where unit capacity limits output.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 裝置容量要以全年潮差的分布與邊際發電量決定，電網則須準備應付兩週一次的出力起伏。
knowledge.textEn: Size capacity from the yearly distribution of range and marginal energy, and have the grid ready for the fortnightly swing in output.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：DNV-ST-0164 潮流渦輪機。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: DNV-ST-0164 Tidal turbines. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「大潮與小潮的能量比」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Energy ratio of springs to neaps" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
水輪機只能朝一個方向使用。
機組容量若只按平均潮差選定，大潮時來不及把水全部通過水輪機，多餘的能量只能經閘門放掉。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
A water turbine can be used in one direction only.
Units sized on mean range alone cannot pass all the water at springs, and surplus energy goes out through the sluices.
quiz.explanation: 機組容量若只按平均潮差選定，大潮時來不及把水全部通過水輪機，多餘的能量只能經閘門放掉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Units sized on mean range alone cannot pass all the water at springs, and surplus energy goes out through the sluices. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 大潮與小潮的能量比：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Energy ratio of springs to neaps: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「大潮與小潮的能量比」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Energy ratio of springs to neaps” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 機組容量若只按平均潮差選定，大潮時來不及把水全部通過水輪機，多餘的能量只能經閘門放掉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「蘭斯潮汐發電站」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Units sized on mean range alone cannot pass all the water at springs, and surplus energy goes out through the sluices. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “La Rance Tidal Power Station”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：電廠的出力因此有一個兩星期的週期：這幾天滿載運轉，下個星期卻只能發出零頭。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Plant output thus has a fortnightly cycle, full load for some days and a fraction the week after.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「潮汐每天都一樣大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tides are the same size every day." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 機組容量若只按平均潮差選定，大潮時來不及把水全部通過水輪機，多餘的能量只能經閘門放掉。
knowledge.textEn: Units sized on mean range alone cannot pass all the water at springs, and surplus energy goes out through the sluices.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
